cohort: 1,079,102 infants born of twin gestations in the U.S. from 2006 to 2013
finding: The rate of cesarean delivery in twin live births in the U.S. peaked at 75.3% in 2009 and decreased to 74.8% in 2013, with the decrease largely attributable to a decline in cesarean among non-Hispanic white women with breech presentations.
